candidate.name: intraday_amount_lorenz_gini_240m
candidate.mechanism: permutation-invariant inequality of the full-session minute amount distribution
candidate.formula: Sort nonnegative amounts b_(1)<=...<=b_(240), require S>0, and return sum_i((2i-241)b_(i))/(239S).
candidate.finite_sample_normalization: The ordinary sample Gini is multiplied by 240/239, mapping equality to 0 and one nonzero minute to 1.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Both ignore clock order but use different global functionals: Shannon entropy weights p log p, whereas normalized Gini integrates Lorenz shortfall and depends on sorted pairwise gaps. Equal entropy does not determine Gini. The frozen numeric gate, not semantic argument, decides practical redundancy.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m, intraday_amount_clock_dispersion_240m and intraday_amount_clock_third_central_moment_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: All three clock moments depend on where amounts occur. Arbitrarily permuting an unchanged amount multiset preserves Gini exactly but generally changes the first, second and third clock moments.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_weak_order_entropy_236t and intraday_top_decile_amount_event_spacing_entropy_25g
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Weak-order and event-spacing factors use temporal ordering or gaps. Strictly increasing transformations preserve their ordinal events but may change Lorenz inequality; arbitrary permutations preserve Gini but change their sequences.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_local_peak_density_238p, intraday_peak_amount_bar_recency_240m and intraday_amount_path_efficiency_238p
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Peak and path mechanisms depend on adjacency or one maximum position. Gini uses all amount magnitudes after sorting and has no adjacency or position.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: late_amount_share_30m, intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m and intraday_opening_auction_amount_share_241m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Fixed-window shares depend on clock cutoffs or the standalone 09:30 row. Campaign261 excludes 09:30 and has no cutoff; relocating identical masses across the 240 positions leaves Gini unchanged.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_session_total_amount_magnitude_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Total magnitude changes under common scaling while Campaign261 is exactly scale invariant. The total is only a positive normalization denominator.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_range_amount_profile_alignment_js_240m and intraday_amount_price_discovery_alignment_js_238p
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Alignment definitions require a second range or return distribution. Campaign261 reads no price field and is determined by the own-stock amount multiset alone.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_relative_amount_share_clock_center_240m and intraday_market_amount_profile_synchronization_240m
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Peer-relative mechanisms require cross-sectional benchmarks. Campaign261 is invariant to every other stock and session.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: rejected Campaign261 concentration siblings
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: No Herfindahl exponent, Theil transform, coefficient of variation, tail, half-session, alternate direction, threshold, filter, subset, fit, model or combination is admitted.

closest_mechanism_challenges.name: candidate49_intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m_v1
closest_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 is a future-only causal price/amount crossing ledger. Campaign261 counts no crossings, reads no Candidate49 history and writes no prospective ledger.

independence_witnesses: Any permutation of a fixed 240-element amount multiset preserves Campaign261 exactly while generally changing clock moments, peaks, paths, fixed-window shares and event spacing.
Two amount distributions can share total and Shannon entropy yet have different Lorenz curves and normalized Gini values.
Uniform positive amounts score 0 and a single positive amount scores 1 regardless of its minute position.

decision.required_next_step: Freeze one exact no-return protocol, pure formula, feature builder and synthetic tests before any Campaign261 local source value is read.
